messages:
zoe: opening a tiny PR to add a compact analytics example + onboarding panel link for quota/tier migration. Need quick sanity check on headers and export shape.

vic: paste the snippets here pls. I want a curl and a minimal export sample.

zoe: curl example (one-liner):

zoe: ```bash
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \\
  -H \"Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY\" \\
  -H \"X-Redwood-Tier: team-standard\" \\
  -d '{"model":"redwood-13b","input":"Summarize changes"}'
```

vic: looks good. add a short analytics export example with usage_tier and legacy burst row.

zoe: export sample:

zoe: ```json
{"rows":[{"meter":"tokens","usage_tier":"team-standard","count":4123},{"meter":"burst_credits","usage_tier":"legacy-grant","count":25}]}
```

vic: please note: legacy burst credits appear in quota API as a transient object named \"graceAllowance\". Also call out that header names are case-insensitive.

zoe: added both notes and a migration CLI dry-run example: `redwood-cli quotas migrate --org $ORG_ID --dry-run`. Also added the onboarding panel link template: https://console.redwood.ai/dashboard/quota_migration_panel?org={{org_id}} (requires console:quota-read).

finance-bot: FYI billing schema change: field rename \"tier_label\" -> \"usage_tier\" deployed 2026-01-05. Docs should mention this to avoid confusion.

zoe: thanks all, PR opened and I'll ping when CI passes. :shipit:
